policies.title: Nigeria F5A: paid Appendix I ordinary-passport eVisa cohort
policies.summary: For these named ordinary-passport catalog codes, Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism eVisa workflow and a paid, unambiguous Appendix I single-entry fee row establish eligibility and electronic issuance before travel.
conditions: Each listed code was reconciled to an Appendix I country row carrying a nonzero single-entry fee. The unambiguous catalog/table label crosswalks are BS/The Bahamas to Bahamas, CZ/Czechia to Czech Republic, KM/Comoro Islands to Comoros, MO/Macao (SAR China) to Macau S.A.R., PS/Palestinian Territory to Palestine, RU/Russian Federation to Russia, ST/São Tomé and Príncipe to Sao Tome and Principe, TR/Türkiye to Turkey, US/United States to United States of America, and VA/Vatican City to Vatican City (Holy See); the other listed code names match directly. No unlisted or zero/Gratis row is inferred.

F5A is a tourism-only, single-entry route. Apply online with the ordinary passport, required documents and fee before travel; the current SLA says the visa certificate is sent by email, which is electronic issuance rather than arrival issuance. It is valid for 90 days from issuance and permits up to 30 days' stay.

F5A excludes ECOWAS States and countries with visa-abolition/waiver agreements. The paid Appendix I single-entry rows resolve that exclusion only for this named cohort. Diplomatic, official, service, temporary, refugee, stateless, residence, work, carrier and final-admission treatment are outside this ordinary-passport visitor policy.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa application
steps: Confirm the passport's named paid Appendix I fee row and the F5A tourism conditions.
Apply online, upload the required documents and pay the stated visa fee.
Receive the visa certificate by email before departure and present it for carrier and final-admission checks.
